strings.dialogue.impact.spawn_door_open: With a deep grinding of stone, the doors swing open. The pressure plates sink into the floor and lock in place.
strings.interact.door.unlocked: The lock turns and the door opens.
strings.interact.door.sealed: It won't budge. Something nearby must open it.
strings.menu.main.title: Seven Gods
strings.menu.settings.title: Settings
strings.inventory.party.empty: No one is in the party

strings.arc.end.title: End of Arc 1 - The Awakening
strings.dialogue.arc1.rest_spot: You rest here for a while. [i]Everyone is back on their feet, fully restored.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.rest_bed_sleep: You lie down on your bed for a while. [i]Everyone is back on their feet, fully restored.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.bed_sign: [i]In the village of Haven, nestled high in the Forgotten Peaks, morning comes with the sound of shared work and gentle laughter. Here, the old ways still hold...[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.bed_wake: [i]You climb out of bed. Across the workshop, Master Finn is already hunched over his anvil, turning a strange metal fragment in the light.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1: [i](looking up, slightly startled)[/i] Ah! Good morning, my young apprentice. Come, come... I have another task for you, though this one's a bit different from our usual errands.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_menu.choice2: Another delivery run to the next village?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_a1: [i](chuckling nervously)[/i] Sharp eyes! These... well, they're fragments of something very old. Not like the usual iron ore or copper ingots I send you to fetch.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_a2: [i](shaking head)[/i] Not this time, I'm afraid. This task is more involved than collecting supplies from the neighbouring settlements.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_a3: Good morning indeed! Though I confess, I've been up most of the night puzzling over these curious artifacts.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_task: You've done well on the smaller errands - herbs from the forest edge, tools for the other villages. But this... requires going deeper into [b]Whisperwood[/b] than you've been before.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_task_2: Traders found these fragments near some old ruins. They were too frightened to explore properly, but they described metalwork I've never seen. I need someone I trust to investigate.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_menu2.choice2: How is this different from my other forest trips?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_b1: [i](chuckling ruefully)[/i] These old bones aren't suited for scrambling through ruins anymore. My adventuring days ended when I settled here to teach you the craft.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_b2: The ruins are deeper in the forest, where the wildlife has been... unpredictable lately. It's not like your herb-gathering trips to the forest edge.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_b3: I knew I could count on you. You've never let me down on the smaller tasks.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_end: But you shouldn't go alone. Young [b]Kira[/b] knows those deep woods better than anyone - she's been exploring them with her father since childhood. She's probably at the [b]training grounds[/b] now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_s1_end_2: Take this with you. It's not much, but it's well-balanced. And a few healing herbs, for any scrapes.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reminder: Kira will be at the training grounds, and her father Thomas will want to see you both before you head into the deep woods.
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_bread: [i](waving)[/i] Off on another adventure with Kira, I see! You two have been exploring together since you were children. Take some bread rolls with you!
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_rations: [i](running up)[/i] Wait! I almost forgot. Special travel rations - they'll keep you going even when regular food won't.
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_idle: Mind the oven - and mind yourselves in those woods!
strings.dialogue.arc1.elena_evening: You're back! Come by the gathering later - the whole village is sharing supper tonight.
strings.dialogue.arc1.garrett_ask: [i](sitting by the well, looking frustrated)[/i] Confound this thing! The water's stopped flowing again. Have a look at that rope, would you? My eyes aren't what they were.
strings.dialogue.arc1.garrett_reward: By the gods! You've got quite the eye, young one. Here, take this - it opens most of the storage buildings if you ever need supplies.
strings.dialogue.arc1.garrett_idle: Water flowing sweet as ever, thanks to you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_puzzle_fail: [i](the rope snags again)[/i] Not quite. You let it slacken and start over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_puzzle_done: The rope slips free - it was caught on a loose stone. Water gushes up from below. [i]Garrett will want to hear about this.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_puzzle: [PH] The rope is tangled around the pulley. You'll need to work it loose, one pull at a time.
strings.dialogue.arc1.well_fixed: Clear, cold water. The rope runs smoothly now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_idle: Are you going on an adventure? Can I come? ...Mum says no.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5: [i](tugging on your cloak)[/i] Are you really going to fight monsters?
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5.choice1: I hope we won't have to fight anything.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5.choice2: Only if they threaten innocent people.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_s5_end: Woah! I'm telling everyone! [i](runs off excitedly)[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return: You're back! Did you find any treasure? Did you fight monsters?
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return.choice1: We found something better than treasure.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return.choice2: We learned most monsters are just scared or hurt.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return.choice3: The real treasure was the friends we made along the way.
strings.dialogue.arc1.child_return_end: [i](eyes wide)[/i] That's the best story ever. Tell me more tomorrow!
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_early: [i](loosing an arrow - thunk, dead centre)[/i] Morning! Finn was looking for you, you know.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3: [i](noticing you)[/i] There you are! Finn sent word you'd be coming by. Ready for another expedition?
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_menu: So what is it this time?
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_menu.choice1: Finn says you know the deeper parts of Whisperwood.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_menu.choice3: This one's more dangerous than our usual trips.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_a1: [i](proudly)[/i] Father's been taking me to the deep woods since I was little. I probably know those paths better than the village roads by now!
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_a2: [i](grinning)[/i] Thanks! All those hunting trips paid off. Plus, someone has to keep you out of trouble.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_a3: [i](eyes lighting up)[/i] Even better! I was getting bored of collecting herbs and mapping the safe paths.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_end: So Finn wants us to explore that old shrine father's always warning about? Deeper than we've ever gone? This should be interesting!
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s3_end_2: But we should talk to father first. He'll want to make sure we're properly prepared.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_village: Father's cabin is just down the path. Let's not keep him waiting.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_forest: The forest feels... different today. Usually there are more bird sounds.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_shrine: You've been quiet since that chamber. Whatever happened in there - I'm with you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_banter_home: Has the village always been like this? Everyone sharing, helping each other... it's just like those murals.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_stay_menu: Want me to hold position here?
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_early: [i](sharpening a hunting knife)[/i] Kira's off at the training grounds, if you're looking for her.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4: [i](looking up)[/i] Ah, there's my favourite pair of troublemakers. Let me guess - Finn's got you heading into the deep woods again?
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_menu.choice2: Kira says you know the area well.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_menu.choice3: Why don't you come with us?
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_a1: [i](chuckling)[/i] You always are. But 'careful' and 'safe' aren't the same thing in those woods.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_a2: [i](nodding)[/i] Used to. These old joints don't handle the underbrush like they used to.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_a3: [i](laughing ruefully)[/i] I wish I could! But my knees creak louder than rusty hinges. I'd only slow you young ones down.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_end: [i](growing serious)[/i] Something's been stirring up the wildlife lately - animals acting more aggressive than natural.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_s4_end_2: If you're both set on this, you'd better know how to defend yourselves. Come - let's see what you can do. [PH] [i]Pick your moves, answer the parry prompts, and give Kira her orders when her turn comes.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after: Not bad! You two might actually survive out there. Now, about equipment...
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_2: [i](hands Kira a fine bow, and you a set of leather armour)[/i] Better range for her, and some protection for you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_3: One more thing... [i](pulls out a small horn)[/i] If you get in real trouble, blow this. It won't bring help, but it might scare off whatever's chasing you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_after_4: Go and see Finn before you leave. He was heading for the [b]village gate[/b].
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_idle: Keep your guard up and your feet moving. And bring my daughter home in one piece.
strings.dialogue.arc1.thomas_violent: [i](quietly)[/i] Kira told me about the guardian. I taught you to defend yourself, not to choose violence first.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map: [i](approaching with a final gift)[/i] Before you go... this might help. It shows the old paths through Whisperwood. Some may be overgrown, but...
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map_2: [i](examining the map, surprised)[/i] Master Finn, this map shows trails I've never seen. How did you...?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_map_3: [i](quickly)[/i] Oh, just old trader routes. Long forgotten now. Be careful out there, both of you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.wisperwood_door: Brambles choke the old trail into Whisperwood. Finn said he'd see you off at the gate before you set out.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_away: Follow the map. And come home safe - both of you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.claw_marks: Wait. Do you see that? Scratch marks - fresh, and deep. Too deep for normal wildlife. Father's stories about the forest changing... maybe they weren't just stories.
strings.dialogue.arc1.blue_lights: [i](nervously)[/i] Those lights... I've never seen anything like them. They're not fireflies.
strings.dialogue.arc1.stone_pillars: [i]Ancient script, worn by time. The carvings show figures working together in harmony.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.stone_pillars_2: These people... they seem organized. Happy, even. But there's no one obviously in charge. The travelling priest said cooperation without proper leadership leads to chaos.
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_1:
[i]"In the beginning, all stood as one,
United beneath the equal sun..."[/i]
[i]A circle is carved beneath the words.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_2:
[i]"From unity comes the strength to grow,
Triangle's peak shall higher go..."[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_3:
[i]"Upon this base, four corners strong,
Square foundations shall last long..."[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_4:
[i]"Precious gem of varied face,
Diamond holds each person's place..."[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.tablet_5:
[i]"Above all else, hope's light shall shine,
Star eternal, truth divine..."[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_pedestals_fail: [i]A gentle chime.[/i] The glowing symbols fade. Nothing bad happens - you can try again.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_pedestals_done: Each symbol glows softly in turn. A harmonious chord rings out, and the great door rumbles open.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_pedestals: [PH] Five stone pedestals ring the vine-covered door: Circle, Triangle, Square, Diamond and Star. The tablets around the courtyard might tell you the order.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_entry_kira: [i](awed)[/i] By the gods... it's massive. And old. Older than anything I've ever seen.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_entry_kira_2: The poem was telling a story about how communities grow and thrive. It's nothing like the priests' stories about divine mandate.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shifting_floor: [PH] This passage looks like- [i](RUMBLE)[/i] ...That was close. The floor almost split us up! Let's stick together.
strings.dialogue.arc1.construct_1_wake: [PH] Runes flare along the stone guardian. It lurches to life and raises its fists!
strings.dialogue.arc1.construct_1_after: The construct shudders, its runes go dark, and it settles back into stillness. Somewhere nearby, a door grinds open.
strings.dialogue.arc1.construct_2_wake: [PH] Runes flare along the stone guardian. It lurches to life and raises its fists!
strings.dialogue.arc1.construct_2_after: The construct shudders, its runes go dark, and it settles back into stillness. Somewhere nearby, a door grinds open.
strings.dialogue.arc1.construct_3_wake: [PH] Runes flare along the stone guardian. It lurches to life and raises its fists!
strings.dialogue.arc1.construct_3_after: The construct shudders, its runes go dark, and it settles back into stillness. The way to the inner chamber is clear.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_crystal_glow: A great crystal hums at the heart of the chamber. Its light feels strangely familiar.
strings.dialogue.arc1.shrine_crystal_dim: The crystal is quiet now, its light gone into you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_s12: [i](echoing softly)[/i] So long... so very long since anyone with a pure heart has entered this place...
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_s12_2: Do not fear, young one. I am... was... a friend to all who seek justice and equality. My name has been forgotten, but my purpose remains.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_s12_menu.choice3: Are you the source of these fragments?
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_a1: [i](sadly)[/i] I was someone who believed that all people deserved to walk in the light. My name... the memory grows dim. You may call me Guide.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_a2: This was a place of learning. Where knowledge flowed like water, shared freely among all who thirsted for understanding. Where titles mattered less than wisdom.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_a3: Yes, child. I am scattered across many places, hidden from those who would destroy even my memory.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_offer: The essence I offer grants understanding - to see beyond the surface of things, to know truth from falsehood, to heal wounds of body and spirit.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_warn: But know this - those who rule now built their power on the ashes of what I represented. Accepting my gift will mark you as an enemy to those who profit from suffering. The choice is yours.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_choice.choice2: What kind of power are you offering?
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_q_power: The power to understand others' pain and heal it. To see through lies and speak truth. To inspire hope where there was only despair.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_q_why: Not because you are special, but because you are willing. That is rarer than you might think.
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_fuse: [PH] [i]The blue light drifts into you. For a heartbeat you see other lives - happy communities, shared knowledge, people building together.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.guide_fuse_2: [b]Soul Fragment obtained.[/b] [i]New senses stir: Soul Sight, Empathic Healing, Truth Sense, Ancient Knowledge.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_s13: You look... different. There's something in your eyes. What happened in there?
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_s13_menu.choice1: Tell her about the soul fragment.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_s13_menu.choice2: Keep it to yourself for now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_told: [i](amazed)[/i] A divine spirit? But the priests say the gods only speak through official channels...
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_secret: Well, whatever happened, I'm glad you're safe.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_paint: Look at these paintings! These people had no kings, no nobles. How did they organize anything?
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_paint_menu.choice2: They seem to have managed just fine.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_paint_menu.choice3: What if the stories we've been told are wrong?
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_wrong: [i](thoughtfully)[/i] That's a dangerous thought. But looking at this place... maybe dangerous thoughts are what we need.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_end: Whatever this place is, it's not finished with us yet.
strings.dialogue.arc1.murals_again: Leaders chosen by merit, and rotated... schools for everyone... I keep reading them over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.central_mural_find: [PH] [i]Your new sight catches a seam in the central mural. Behind it, a hidden compartment holds a second shard of blue light.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.central_mural_find_2: [i]Memories flood in: six figures of terrible power marching on a city of light, people fleeing, and one who chose to shatter rather than let them fall.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.central_mural_find_3: [i](stronger now)[/i] Yes... I remember more. There were six others. They feared what we represented. They feared people would see there was another way.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_dormant: Three great stone guardians stand motionless before the throne.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_rest: The three wardens stand still, their long watch finally over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s14: [i](three deep voices, as one)[/i] Who... dares... disturb... the... sanctuary?
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s14_2: [PH] All three of them! Aim for the joints - that's how father taught me to hunt large game!
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16: [PH] [i](the guardian stops, voice becoming clear)[/i] The light... I remember the light...
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_2: Bearer of the Light... why do you carry the Master's essence? I was meant to guard this place from those who would exploit its knowledge. But you...
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice1: I want to restore what was lost.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice2: I seek to understand the truth.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice3: I carry the soul of the one you served.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_s16_menu.choice4: [Strike it down while it is weak]
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_p1: Restoration... yes. The Master spoke of this possibility before the end came.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_p2: Truth. The rarest treasure of all. The six who came before sought only power.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_p3: [i](kneeling)[/i] Master... even in fragments, your light shines true.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_peace: I have failed in my duty. Much of the knowledge I was meant to protect has been lost. But not all.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_peace_2: [i](activating a hidden mechanism in the throne)[/i] Take these. They contain not just power, but memory. Memory of how things could be.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_violent: Your blade finds the crack in its chest. The light inside gutters out, and a shard of blue falls free.
strings.dialogue.arc1.warden_violent_2: [i](troubled)[/i] We... we could have talked to it. I heard it trying to speak near the end. Why did we have to...?
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17: [PH] [i]You lay a hand on the ancient device. The soul fragments inside you answer, and light fills the room.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17_2: [i]A city at its height - people learning, building, sharing. Then a crisis: refugees arriving from every border. Six powers meeting in secret. A war. And at the end of it, the one called [b]Equalitas[/b] giving themselves to the light so the people could escape.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17_3: Now you understand. The histories were rewritten. The truth was buried. But fragments remain, waiting for those brave enough to seek them.
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17_4: [i](overwhelmed)[/i] Everything we were taught... the kingdoms, the gods we worship... they destroyed something beautiful.
strings.dialogue.arc1.viewer_s17_5: [b]Obtained:[/b] a map of the other fragment sites, and records of the war against Equalitas. [i]Time to go home and talk to Finn.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.wounded_wolf: [PH] A Thornwolf lies in the undergrowth, whimpering. With your new sight you can see the corruption burning through it - it isn't vicious. It's in pain.
strings.dialogue.arc1.wolf_heal: Warmth flows from your hands. The dark veins fade, and the wolf's breathing eases. It licks your hand, then pads away into the trees.
strings.dialogue.arc1.wolf_heal_2: You can heal them? That's incredible! No wonder they were acting strange - they were suffering!
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal: [i](looking up from the forge)[/i] Welcome back. I can see from your eyes that you found more than metal fragments.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_2: I suppose it's time for truth. [color=#7fb6ff]I've been waiting seventy years for someone like you to appear.[/color]
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_3: [PH] [i]The words glow faint blue - your Truth Sense marks them as a lie.[/i]
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu.choice1: Seventy years? You're not that old.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu.choice2: You've been waiting for me specifically?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_r1: [i](chuckling)[/i] Ah, you caught that, did you? Sharp eyes... or perhaps something more than eyes now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_r2: [i](smiling mysteriously)[/i] Not you personally, but someone like you. Someone who could carry the burden.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_r3: [i](noticing your expression)[/i] I see you're learning to read between the lines. Good.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_b: What I said wasn't entirely false, just... incomplete. What happened to you in that shrine was no accident. Use those abilities wisely - not everyone appreciates having their words examined.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu2.choice1: You're one of them, aren't you? A follower of Equalitas.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu2.choice2: How long have you known what I would find?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu2.choice3: The whole village knows, don't they?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_q1: [i](smiling sadly)[/i] The last, I believe. Though I pray there are others, hidden in distant places.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_q2: I knew when I first saw you. There was something familiar about your spirit - something that reminded me of the old days.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_q3: Some suspect. Most simply live the old ways without knowing why. Haven is... special. We've preserved what we could, even if we couldn't preserve the memory of why.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c: [i](realization dawning)[/i] The village... the way we share everything... this isn't normal, is it? Other places aren't like this.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c_2: Your generation was raised in our ways without knowing their origin. Natural kindness, unforced by doctrine.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c_3: [PH] [i](opening a hidden compartment in the forge)[/i] This hammer was forged in the last days of the war. It can shape metal touched by divine essence. One day soon, it will strengthen your blade.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_c_4: But know this - the six who rule now have agents everywhere. They watch for the old power returning. You will be hunted.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu3.choice1: Then we'll have to be stronger than they are.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu3.choice2: Maybe it's time people knew the truth.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_menu3.choice3: Are you saying I should hide this power?
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_h1: Strength isn't always about power, young one. Sometimes it's about knowing when to stand and when to move wisely.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_h2: The truth is dangerous. But lies are poison that spreads with time. Perhaps you're right.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_h3: I'm saying you should be careful. Not that you should do nothing.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_d: The soul of Equalitas was shattered into seven pieces. You carry three of them now. The other four lie hidden in the domains of the six false gods.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_rev_d_2: [i](studying the map)[/i] These locations... they're in the heart of enemy territory. The Iron Theocracy, the Merchant Republic...
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_path.choice1: We have to try. People deserve to know the truth.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_path.choice2: Maybe we should gather allies first.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_path.choice3: This is bigger than I thought. I need time to think.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_p1: Brave, but dangerous. The direct path often leads to martyrdom.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_p2: Wisdom. There are others who preserve fragments of the old ways. Finding them will be crucial.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_p3: Time is a luxury, but wisdom... wisdom is a necessity.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_end: Whatever path you choose, you won't walk it alone. Rest now. Talk to Kira in the morning - she has a lot to think about too.
strings.dialogue.arc1.finn_reveal_done: Kira was out by the well, last I saw. Go to her.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21: [i](staring into the well)[/i] I've been thinking all night about what we saw. My whole life, I believed the priests - that some people were born to rule and others to serve. But those murals...
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21_menu.choice2: It's hard when everything you've been taught is wrong.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21_menu.choice3: You don't have to decide everything right now.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_21a: [i](firmly)[/i] I believe people should be free to help each other without someone above them taking credit. I believe knowledge should be shared, not hoarded.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_21b: [i](nodding)[/i] It is. But maybe it's also liberating? Like I can finally ask the questions I was afraid to ask before.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_21c: [i](smiling)[/i] You're right. But I know enough to know I want to help. Whatever comes next, I'm with you.
strings.dialogue.arc1.kira_s21_end: I want to see more of those places. And if there are people suffering under lies... [i](drawing her bow)[/i] well, I'm a pretty good shot. Come on - Finn's gathering everyone for supper.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_violent: [i](quietly, before the others arrive)[/i] Some of the villagers say they can feel something dark about you since you came back. Remember who you want to be.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_1: [i](standing to address the gathering)[/i] Our young friends will be leaving us soon. They go to seek truth in a world that has forgotten it.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_1_2: [PH] [i](privately)[/i] Take these - supplies for the road, and a crystal you can use to reach me. Remember: you carry more than power. You carry hope.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_menu.choice3: I'll come back when this is over.
strings.dialogue.arc1.farewell_2: [i](placing a hand on your shoulder)[/i] You already make me proud. Now go, and show the world what's possible.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_1: [i](adjusting her pack at the village edge)[/i] So... where do we go first?
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice: [PH] The world map would open here.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice.choice1: The Merchant Republic - investigate economic oppression.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice.choice2: The Scholar Kingdom - seek hidden knowledge.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_choice.choice3: The Warrior Clans - face direct conflict.
strings.dialogue.arc1.road_end_1: [i]And so begins a journey that will shake the foundations of the world. Two young people, carrying the light of forgotten wisdom, step forward into uncertainty...[/i]
